justification: The only correspondences are extremely generic: an animal head presented in profile and a horizontal run of small repeated marks in the upper zone, both of which any tradition could produce independently. A shows an actual mounted horned skull with sparse schematic red geometric strokes on a blank plaster surface, whereas B is a single dense, highly detailed relief composition of a crested, feathered bird-headed creature with beak, eye, mane and clawed limb filling the entire field within a bordered frame — no shared motif, posture or relationship.
